extracted.name: Ham and Split Pea Soup Recipe — A Great Soup
extracted.description: This tasty split pea soup with ham from Chef John is rich and hearty with a subtle smoky flavor; it is a super satisfying way to use leftover ham.
ingredient_lines: salt and ground black pepper to taste
instruction_lines: Melt butter in a large soup pot over medium-low heat. Stir in celery, onion, and sliced garlic; cook and stir until onions are translucent but not brown, 5 to 8 minutes.
Stir in split peas, ham, and bay leaf. Pour in chicken stock and water; stir to combine and simmer until peas are tender and soup has thickened, about 1 hour and 15 minutes. Stir occasionally.
Season with salt and black pepper to serve.
